market_summary: Gold (XAUUSD) presents a clear high-confluence short setup as price breaks below Put Wall #1 in a negative gamma regime with strong bearish CVD and VWAP rejection. EURUSD, GBPUSD, US100, and BTCUSD are held back by range-bound value area consolidation, GEX Call Wall resistance, or low volume / CVD divergence.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4028.54) and far below POC (4043.68). CVD is -2.53 (BEARISH) with negative slope. NEW_YORK_SESSION active. Price is below VWAP (4035.82) and EMA50 (4025.69), stretching near lower ATR band (3996.29). RVOL showed recent sell expansion. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (3993.64); price is below Flip and Put Wall #1 (4013.82) is broken, accelerating move toward Session Low (3987.10). Strongly aligned short momentum.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downsloping VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection below Gamma Flip 3993.64 testing Session Low

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.10824..VAH 1.11472) right near POC (1.10920). CVD is -14,725 (BEARISH) but slope is positive (+2844). NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well below VWAP (1.11259) and EMA50 (1.11181), but currently hovering mid-channel between EMA20 and lower ATR band. RVOL is low (0.306). Sitting just above Session Low support (1.10824) with no momentum driver or clean rejection.

Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.32661..VAH 1.33233), below POC (1.32813). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1859). NEW_YORK_SESSION. Below downsloping VWAP (1.33069) and EMA50 (1.33012). Price is flatlining mid-channel near EMA20 without yellow RVOL spikes (RVOL 0.326). Support at Session Low (1.32661) is holding, showing lack of immediate breakdown momentum.
signals.level_event: none, tight consolidation near Session Low

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (28455.81) and above POC (28263.52). CVD is +14.08 (BULLISH). NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is well above VWAP (28195.82) and EMA50 (28289.24), extended near the upper ATR band. US100 volume is normal tick volume (US100 caveat). GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING above Gamma Flip (28338.54). Price is directly testing Call Wall #1 (28553.66) and Session High (28589.59), where positive gamma suppresses further immediate explosive upside without room to scalp.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish above strongly rising VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection at Call Wall #1 / Session High

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (73998.28) and far above POC (73660.42). NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is above VWAP (73770.80) and EMA50 (73910.37). However, CVD is -0.06 (BEARISH/NEUTRAL) diverging from price high, RVOL is low (0.615) with no yellow spikes, and the forming bar is retracing from resistance at Session High (74706.20) near upper ATR band (74652.53). Lack of volume and delta divergence signals potential bull exhaustion.
